lines.zh: 我的根须在土上挪，留下浅痕。
lines.en: My roots shuffle over the soil and leave faint marks.

lines.zh: 花瓣擦过草丛，沙沙地响。
lines.en: My petals brush the grass with a dry whisper.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，隔着半步距离。
lines.en: I follow you at half a step's distance.

lines.zh: 夜里凉，我走得比白天有精神。
lines.en: The night is cool, and I walk livelier than by day.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，怕把花苞碰掉。
lines.en: I shuffle carefully, afraid of knocking the bud loose.

lines.zh: 叶子拖在地上，沾了露水。
lines.en: My leaves drag on the ground and gather dew.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，根须一点一点探。
lines.en: I go around stones, roots testing the way.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身体大，风一吹就散。
lines.en: My shadow is larger than I am and scatters in the wind.

lines.zh: 我走路时花心朝上，护着里面的东西。
lines.en: I walk with my flower face up, guarding what is inside.

lines.zh: 你停下，我也停，花瓣还在抖。
lines.en: You stop, I stop, and my petals keep trembling.

lines.zh: 我悄悄跟着，不想吓到你。
lines.en: I trail you quietly, not wanting to startle you.

lines.zh: 泥土松，我陷下去半寸又拔出来。
lines.en: The soil is loose; I sink half an inch and pull free.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地开在夜里，等人经过。
lines.en: I bloom motionless in the night, waiting for someone to pass.

lines.zh: 花瓣一张一合，像在慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: My petals open and close as if breathing slowly.

lines.zh: 我把花粉抖落在脚边的土里。
lines.en: I shake pollen onto the soil at my feet.

lines.zh: 露水从叶尖滚下去，我看了看。
lines.en: Dew rolls off a leaf tip, and I watch it go.

lines.zh: 天快亮了，我开始有点困。
lines.en: Dawn is near, and I begin to feel sleepy.

lines.zh: 我数着虫子的叫声，一直数不清。
lines.en: I count the insects' calls and keep losing track.

lines.zh: 根须在土里换了个方向。
lines.en: My roots shift to a new direction underground.

lines.zh: 我朝着月光，把花苞撑开一点。
lines.en: I lean to the moonlight and open the bud a little.

lines.zh: 有东西爬过我的叶子，我没动。
lines.en: Something crawls over my leaf, and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我合上花瓣，又舍不得，重新张开。
lines.en: I close my petals, then regret it and open again.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有脚步，就先站直。
lines.en: I hear steps far off and straighten up first.

lines.zh: 花心的味道招来一只蛾，我让它停。
lines.en: My scent draws a moth, and I let it rest.

lines.zh: 我把枯掉的那片叶慢慢卷起来。
lines.en: I slowly curl the one withered leaf aside.

lines.zh: 我在这里守了很久，没觉得久。
lines.en: I have guarded here a long while and felt none of it.

lines.zh: 我把根须往下探，摸到了湿土。
lines.en: I push a root down and find wet soil.

lines.zh: 一只蜜蜂绕我三圈，又走了。
lines.en: A bee circles me three times and leaves.

lines.zh: 夜里很静，我听得见自己的汁液。
lines.en: The night is quiet; I can hear my own sap.

lines.zh: 我的花苞又鼓了一点，快开了。
lines.en: My bud swells a little more. Almost open.

lines.zh: 我吸气的时候，会有嘶的一声。
lines.en: When I draw breath, it comes out as a hiss.

lines.zh: 天光从东边来，我慢慢转身。
lines.en: Light comes from the east. I turn slowly toward it.

lines.zh: 我抬起花盘，认了认你的脸。
lines.en: I lift my flower face and study yours.

lines.zh: 你身上有阳光的味道，我喜欢。
lines.en: You smell of sunlight, and I like it.

lines.zh: 我把花瓣朝你转过去，像转头。
lines.en: I turn my petals toward you the way others turn their heads.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就低了一点。
lines.en: You crouch, so I lower myself a little.

lines.zh: 我在看你的手，有没有伤。
lines.en: I am checking your hands for wounds.

lines.zh: 你走近，我的花心亮了一下。
lines.en: As you come close, my flower heart brightens.

lines.zh: 我歪着花茎，把你看了个遍。
lines.en: I bend my stem and look you over completely.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里有光，跟我夜里的白不一样。
lines.en: Your eyes hold a light unlike my white night-glow.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，夜里只有你会来。
lines.en: I am not afraid; at night only you come.

lines.zh: 我用叶尖碰了碰你的鞋，算是招呼。
lines.en: I touch your boot with a leaf tip as a greeting.

lines.zh: 我的花心一直朝着你转。
lines.en: My blossom keeps turning toward you.

lines.zh: 我开花就是为这个的。
lines.en: Opening like this is what I am for.

lines.zh: 花瓣掉了一半，我还站着。
lines.en: Half my petals are gone, and I am still standing.

lines.zh: 我疼得把花苞收紧了。
lines.en: The pain makes me pull the bud tight.

lines.zh: 叶子上破了个口，汁水流出来。
lines.en: A leaf is torn, and sap runs from it.

lines.zh: 我嘶了一声，但不是要炸。
lines.en: I hiss, but not because I am about to burst.

lines.zh: 泥溅到我脸上，我眨了眨眼。
lines.en: Mud splashes my face, and I blink.

lines.zh: 断掉的叶子挂在那儿，我不去管。
lines.en: A broken leaf hangs there, and I leave it.

lines.zh: 这份疼我记着，等它赔。
lines.en: I keep this pain and will collect on it.

lines.zh: 我往你身边靠，想找个挡的。
lines.en: I lean toward you, looking for cover.

lines.zh: 花心被刮了一下，颜色淡了。
lines.en: My flower heart is scraped, and its color fades.

lines.zh: 我还没到要炸的时候。
lines.en: It is not yet time for me to burst.

lines.zh: 你手里是骨粉吗？我闻到了。
lines.en: Is that bone meal in your hand? I can smell it.

lines.zh: 一点清水，我就能多开一会儿。
lines.en: A little clean water and I could stay open longer.

lines.zh: 你把那朵花举起来，我伸长了茎。
lines.en: You raise that flower, and my stem stretches.

lines.zh: 我朝亮的地方挪，改不了。
lines.en: I drift toward anything bright; I cannot help it.

lines.zh: 你给我一把土，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Give me a handful of soil and I will come with you.

lines.zh: 那袋子里的味道，像是同类。
lines.en: Something in that sack smells like kin.

lines.zh: 你在浇水，我就凑过去接。
lines.en: You are watering, so I lean over to catch it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的种子，很想要。
lines.en: I stare at the seeds in your hand; I want them.

lines.zh: 有蜜的味道，我忍不住。
lines.en: There is the smell of nectar, and I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 你别走那么快，我跟不上。
lines.en: Do not walk so fast; I cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的花瓣，我缩了一下。
lines.en: You touch my petals, and I flinch inward.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，把花粉蹭了一片。
lines.en: I bump your leg and smear pollen across it.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边让开，根须绊了一下。
lines.en: I step aside from your feet and trip on my roots.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的叶子，我嘶了一声。
lines.en: You step on a leaf, and I let out a hiss.

lines.zh: 我贴着你站，怕你踩空。
lines.en: I stand close to you, afraid you will miss a step.

lines.zh: 撞歪了花茎，我半天才正过来。
lines.en: My stem bends crooked and takes a while to right.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，我让了半步。
lines.en: We crowd together, and I give up half a step.

lines.zh: 你撞过来时，我把花苞护在身后。
lines.en: When you bump me, I shield the bud behind me.

lines.zh: 我退开，土被带起一小撮。
lines.en: I pull back, lifting a small clod of soil.

lines.zh: 别推我，我肚子里有东西。
lines.en: Do not shove me; I am carrying something inside.

lines.zh: 我们两朵花对着开，中间隔着风。
lines.en: We open facing each other with the wind between us.

lines.zh: 我的花粉落在她的花瓣上，很轻。
lines.en: My pollen settles on her petals, barely touching.

lines.zh: 我们一起把根往深处扎。
lines.en: We drive our roots deeper together.

lines.zh: 她的花色淡一些，夜里正好配。
lines.en: Her color is paler, which suits the night.

lines.zh: 我替她挡了一阵风，花瓣才张开。
lines.en: I block the wind for her until her petals open.

lines.zh: 我们相约在同一夜开，谁也没迟。
lines.en: We agreed to bloom the same night, and neither was late.

lines.zh: 花谢了，我们各自把种子埋好。
lines.en: The blooms fade, and each of us buries the seeds.

lines.zh: 她的香比我的浓，我靠得近了些。
lines.en: Her scent is stronger than mine, so I lean closer.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只用花心对着。
lines.en: We do not speak; we only face each other, flower to flower.

lines.zh: 这一夜过去，我们就都累了。
lines.en: When the night ends, we are both tired.

lines.zh: 我用叶子卷起那颗种子。
lines.en: I curl a leaf around the seed.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，我捡了放进花心。
lines.en: What falls, I pick up and tuck into my flower heart.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗小石子，没什么用。
lines.en: I pick up a pebble, which is of no use.

lines.zh: 露水聚在叶上，我喝了一点。
lines.en: Dew gathers on a leaf, and I drink a little.

lines.zh: 我捡起你掉的扣子，替你留着。
lines.en: I pick up your fallen button and keep it for you.

lines.zh: 一片落叶压在我身上，我抖了抖。
lines.en: A fallen leaf lands on me, and I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我把种子塞进土里，用叶子盖上。
lines.en: I push the seed into the soil and cover it with a leaf.

lines.zh: 我捡起碎花瓣，拼不回原样。
lines.en: I gather broken petals that will not fit back together.

lines.zh: 有颗果子滚过来，我推着走。
lines.en: A berry rolls over, and I push it along.

lines.zh: 我把宝贝压在根下，谁也看不见。
lines.en: I press my treasure under the roots where none can see.

lines.zh: 有东西朝你来了，我先转过身。
lines.en: Something comes for you, and I turn first.

lines.zh: 那个影子不是你的，我认得。
lines.en: That shadow is not yours, and I know it.

lines.zh: 我看见它了，花心开始收紧。
lines.en: I see it, and my flower heart begins to close.

lines.zh: 它踩进我的范围，就算数了。
lines.en: It steps into my ground, and that counts.

lines.zh: 我嘶响一声，这是给你的警告。
lines.en: I hiss once — that's your warning.

lines.zh: 那个声音不对，我把它记下。
lines.en: That sound is wrong, and I mark it.

lines.zh: 它要碰你，就先碰我。
lines.en: If it wants you, it goes through me.

lines.zh: 我朝那边开得更大，装得像没事。
lines.en: I open wider toward it, pretending nothing is wrong.

lines.zh: 你身边多了一个，我数得清。
lines.en: There is one more beside you, and I can count.

lines.zh: 目标进了我的夜，我等着。
lines.en: The target has entered my night, and I wait.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，花瓣尽量不动。
lines.en: I creep closer, keeping my petals still.

lines.zh: 喉咙里有气在鼓，我压着没放。
lines.en: Air swells in my throat, and I hold it back.

lines.zh: 我把花瓣张开，香气收进根里。
lines.en: I spread my petals and pull the scent into my roots.

lines.zh: 我挡在你和它中间，扎根站定。
lines.en: I plant myself between you and it.

lines.zh: 我的花苞鼓起来，亮得发白。
lines.en: My bud swells and glows white.

lines.zh: 它看我，我就继续装成一丛花。
lines.en: It looks at me, so I keep pretending to be a shrub.

lines.zh: 近了，再近一点。
lines.en: Closer. A little closer.

lines.zh: 我开始发出很轻的嘶声。
lines.en: I begin a very soft hiss.

lines.zh: 它没退，那就没有别的办法。
lines.en: It does not retreat, so there is no other way.

lines.zh: 我朝前倾，把重量压到根上。
lines.en: I lean forward and press my weight into the roots.

lines.zh: 我炸开的时候，把它罩在里面。
lines.en: When I burst, I close it inside the blast.

lines.zh: 花瓣飞得到处都是，我不后悔。
lines.en: Petals scatter everywhere, and I do not regret it.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了整个花苞。
lines.en: That one cost me the whole bud.

lines.zh: 尘土落下，你在后面没事吧。
lines.en: The dust settles; are you all right back there?

lines.zh: 我把它推出去，自己散了半边。
lines.en: I throw it clear and lose half of myself doing it.

lines.zh: 热浪扑到我自己身上，也很疼。
lines.en: The heat washes over me too, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 它退了，我的根还留在原地。
lines.en: It retreats, and my roots stay where they were.

lines.zh: 我把花粉全撒出去，呛得它睁不开眼。
lines.en: I fling all my pollen out and blind it.

lines.zh: 这一炸不算漂亮，但够用。
lines.en: It was not a clean burst, but it served.

lines.zh: 我护住了你，这就行。
lines.en: I kept you safe, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 天黑了，母株张开，我从里面爬出来。
lines.en: Night falls, the mother bush opens, and I climb out.

lines.zh: 夜里第一阵风过后，我开了。
lines.en: After the night's first wind, I open.

lines.zh: 花苞裂开，我先伸出两片叶子。
lines.en: The bud splits, and I put out two leaves first.

lines.zh: 我从土里顶出来，带着湿气。
lines.en: I push up out of the soil, still damp.

lines.zh: 月光落在花心上，我就活了。
lines.en: Moonlight falls on my flower heart, and I come alive.

lines.zh: 有人把种子埋在这里，于是我来了。
lines.en: Someone buried a seed here, so here I am.

lines.zh: 我抖掉花瓣上的土，慢慢站起来。
lines.en: I shake the soil off my petals and rise slowly.

lines.zh: 这一夜很长，我开得刚刚好。
lines.en: The night is long, and I opened just in time.

lines.zh: 母株抖了一下，把花苞让给我。
lines.en: The mother bush shivers and gives the bud to me.

lines.zh: 我出现时没什么声音，只有香味。
lines.en: I arrive with no sound, only a scent.

lines.zh: 我落地的地方，草自己让开了。
lines.en: Where I land, the grass makes room.

lines.zh: 天边还黑着，我已经在守了。
lines.en: The sky is still dark, and I am already keeping watch.

lines.zh: 火苗一舔，花瓣立刻卷起来。
lines.en: A lick of flame and my petals curl at once.

lines.zh: 摔下去时我护住花苞，叶子先着地。
lines.en: I land on my leaves, curling around the bud.

lines.zh: 水泡到根上，我憋着不开花。
lines.en: Water rises past my roots, and I hold my bloom shut.

lines.zh: 别人的炸响，让我差点提前开口。
lines.en: Someone else's blast nearly makes me hiss early.

lines.zh: 箭穿过花瓣，我低头看了看那个洞。
lines.en: An arrow pierces a petal, and I look down at the hole.

lines.zh: 那股光让我的花心发麻，很陌生。
lines.en: The glow leaves my flower heart tingling, unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 没有月光，我就慢慢地瘪下去。
lines.en: Without moonlight, I slowly wither at the edges.

lines.zh: 雷照过来，我一瞬间开得很大。
lines.en: Lightning flashes, and for an instant I bloom wide.

lines.zh: 往下掉时，我把花瓣全收紧了。
lines.en: Falling, I pull every petal tight around me.
